prompt:
Classify this customer message for Acme Logistics into one category.

<message>I was charged the delivery fee twice on my October statement for the same parcel.</message>

Extract the invoice number, the total amount due in EUR (as a number) and the due date (YYYY-MM-DD).

<invoice>Fjord Freight AS (fictional). Invoice INV-2026-0419 for Acme Logistics. Line-haul Oslo to Hamburg, 2 trailers. Subtotal 1,250.00 EUR. VAT 25%: 312.50 EUR. Total due 1,562.50 EUR. Payment terms: 30 days from the invoice date of 2026-10-21, due 2026-11-20.</invoice>

It is Monday 07:00. Acme Logistics must move 3 pallets from Rotterdam to Lyon so they arrive by Thursday 17:00. Loading takes 3 hours and must finish before the shipment departs; loading can start now. Options:
A: road, departs Tuesday 08:00, arrives Thursday 08:00, costs 840 EUR.
B: rail and road, departs Monday 09:00, arrives Thursday 09:00, costs 610 EUR.
C: express road, departs Wednesday 06:00, arrives Thursday 06:00, costs 1,150 EUR.
Which is the cheapest option that is feasible and arrives on time? Give the letter and a one-sentence reason.
